verdict.rationale: Convex documents its own Custom Auth Integration that accepts any OpenID Connect-compatible identity provider. It also documents integrations with WorkOS AuthKit (B2B) and Auth0. That gives an OIDC-based enterprise SSO path, but any actual SSO/MFA policy enforcement would sit in the external IdP rather than in Convex. Its built-in Convex Auth library covers only social providers, email/SMS OTP, and passwords. missing for 10: any documented MFA capability or MFA enforcement, SAML support, a first-party way to require SSO for users, independent corroboration.
